integrity: Analytical proof covers all stated positive parameters. Finite simulations and numerical checks supplement but do not replace proof. No independent audit or experimental confirmation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Assumes stationary homogeneous Poisson versus perfectly periodic disturbance clocks, equal event amplitude, exponential memory and response kernel, independent responses with no feedback; not biologically calibrated; no pathwise or energy-impact ordering is claimed. Historical priority remains provisional because older habituation work was not fully accessible.
title: A unique Poisson–periodic crossover for memory-dependent wildlife disturbance
